relationships.source_text: International payment systems will migrate to the ISO 20022 standard of the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) in interbank payments by 2025.
European banks, payment institutions and the euro area clearing and settlement systems have already adopted the ISO 20022 standard.

The objective of the Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA) is that consumers, companies and organisations can pay and receive payments in euro with the same conditions, rights and obligations regardless of whether the payment is domestic or international.

relationships.source_text: The purpose of this guide is to describe the usage of the customer-to-bank ISO 20022 Payment Initiation message in credit transfers. This description is based on the current accepted SEPA Credit Transfer Customer-to-PSP Implementation Guidelines1 (version 2023 1.1) and the SEPA Instant Credit Transfer Customer-to-PSP Implementation Guidelines2 (version 2023 1.2).

relationships.source_text: The latest versions of the SEPA Rulebooks and Implementation Guidelines should always be checked from the European Payments Council (EPC) website at www.europeanpaymentscouncil.eu.

entities.name: Regulation (EU) 2024/886
entities.source_text: The Instant Payments Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2024/886) determines that from 9 October 2025, a payer’s payment service provider (PSP, banks included) must offer to the payer a service ensuring verification of the payee to whom the payer intends to send a credit transfer.

entities.name: Payer’s PSP
entities.source_text: The payer’s PSP must verify whether the payment account identifier and the name of the payee provided by the payer match those registered by the payee’s PSP.

entities.name: VOP
entities.source_text: The VOP service is intended only for verifying the payee before submitting the payment file.

entities.name: Banks
entities.source_text: Banks perform VOP checks for the ISO 20022-compliant C2B pain.001 structured data of companies.

entities.name: Companies
entities.source_text: This data includes the full payment information, not just the name and IBAN combination required for the VOP.

entities.name: Corporate customers
entities.source_text: Corporate customers may have the payee information verified through their system before submitting the payments to their bank in the C2B payment file.

entities.name: Payee
entities.source_text: The VOP service in C2B payment files is part of a national corporate file transfer solution.

entities.name: Bank
entities.source_text: The channel offered by the bank includes a separate file type for the VOP service, which only submits the data for the verification of the payee, not for payment.

entities.name: Customer
entities.source_text: When the customer has checked the matching result and made any possible changes to the payment orders as a result, the customer submits the normal C2B payment file to the bank.

entities.name: VOP request
entities.source_text: Corporate customers can opt in to the VOP service by making a VOP request using the designated file type included in the data transfer channel.

entities.name: EPC
entities.source_text: Under the EPC’s definition, the name of the payee as given by the payer is said to be a match with a name registered by the responding PSP when there is an exact match (i.e. no deviation at all) of the first name and the last name.
